surprises: ARY SELLS OIL AND GHEE LOOSE, BY THE LITRE — the category's biggest earner and its biggest legal exposure. 'Loose Desi Ghee' (07NI, unit Ltr) sold 1,396 L for ₹13,89,024 = 46% of all category sales, and 'Soyabean Fortune_L' (0GC3, unit Ltr) sold 1,280 L for ₹1,78,800 out of the Basement counter — bought 1,280 L from Dharam Pal & Sons Jun-Jul 2026 and passed straight through by the litre. There is also 'Lmk C Oil' (0EIE, unit Ltr) and 'Desi Ghee 1 Kg_L' on the same pattern. Per the regulation the ideal list flags (FSSAI: multi-source edible oil only in sealed packs ≤15 kg; Maharashtra FDA banned loose edible oil Aug 2026 with penalties to 7 years), decanted oil sale is prosecutable — and ARY is doing ₹1.79 L/yr of it.

EVERY NATIONAL GHEE BRAND IS DEAD STOCK. All 9 branded ghee SKUs — Amul Cow 1Ltr, Amul Pure 500Ml, Verka Cow 1 Ltr, Britannia 1 Ltr, Britannia 500 Ml, Dodla 200Ml, Dodla 500Ml, Mahaan Cow 500Ml, Shraddha 200Ml, Ashtavinayak — sold ₹0 in 12 months, with one exception of ₹441 (Mahaan Ghee 200 Ml, 3 pcs, Sep 2025). ₹15.16 L of ghee moved and 92% of it was unbranded loose. Adding more branded ghee is not the fix; the small-pack (200/500 ml) format is the real hole.

THE INSTITUTIONAL KITCHENS BUY OFF-LEDGER, SO THE CATEGORY LOOKS SMALLER THAN IT IS. Jivo Canola Refined Edible Oil 15 Ltr (00AL) was purchased 160 tins / ₹4,00,000 @₹2,500 in 12 months — from Jivo Wellness itself (intercompany) — and has ZERO retail sales: it is stock-transferred into 'Ary G Canteen' and 'Ary Apple A Day' and written off as 'consumed' (49 tins in one journal at G Canteen). Gagan Vanaspati Oil 1 Kg runs the same way (blocks of 20-80 packs consumed at G Canteen, 22.6/5.24/3.45 at Ary Lite). So the mess/canteon frying-fat demand the ideal list wants rate-contracted is already ₹4 L+/yr, it just never appears as a sale — and it is being served by a 15 L canola tin and 1 kg vanaspati packs, with no palmolein and no 15 kg tin anywhere.

THE CATEGORY IS ONLY ~3.4% OF ARY. ₹30.21 L of 12-month sales against ₹8.96 Cr = ₹50 per resident per month out of a ₹1,493 wallet. Cooking fat is the least skippable thing in a grocery basket and normally runs 8-10%; the shortfall sits almost exactly on the missing lines — palmolein (nothing), institutional tins (nothing sold), branded ghee (all dead), 5 L jars (only canola sells).

62% OF THE SHELF IS DEAD: 79 of 127 active SKUs in the two oil/ghee groups sold ₹0 in 12 months, including virtually the whole national-brand wall — Fortune Kachi Ghani 1 Ltr, Fortune Sunlite, Fortune Rice Bran Health, Fortune Cottonlite, Dhara Soyabean, Patanjali Mustard, Saffola Gold ×2, Ruchi Soyumm, Ambuja ×2, Vibhor ×2, P Mark ×3, Kasturi ×3, Jyoti Kiran ×4, Del Monte ×2, Figaro ×3.

THIS IS A CAPTIVE-BRAND STORE, NOT A NEUTRAL ASSORTMENT. Jivo (the parent, Jivo Wellness Pvt Ltd) supplies 33 of the 127 SKUs and ₹6.6 L+ of sales, and it is the ONLY brand that moves in canola, olive, coconut, sesame, rice bran, groundnut and 5 L mustard. There is also a 13-SKU CANOLA sub-line the ideal list never mentions (Jivo Canola Oil 5 Ltr Cold Press ₹97,997; 1 Ltr Cold Press ₹48,170; 1 Ltr Pouch ₹23,058) plus the ₹4 L institutional tin — ~₹1.7 L retail. Canola is not a North-India staple; it is here because the parent makes it.

MISFILED SKUS DISTORT ANY GROUP-BASED COUNT. Inside 'Edible Oil & Ghee' and 'Oil & Ghee' sit 'Amul Paneer 1 Kg', 'Verka Cow Milk 1 Litre', 'Pain Oil 250 Ml' and 'Pain Relief Oil 1 Ltr' (all ₹0). Conversely every edible-grade Parachute coconut oil — ₹1.20 L of sales — is filed under Personal Care→Hair Oil, and Hamdard Roghan Badam is under Medicare. Group 122+140 = 123 real edible-oil/ghee SKUs; category-wide including the strays it is ~140 SKUs and ~₹31.6 L.

THE PREMIUM DESI-COW SUPPLY LINE ALREADY EXISTS UPSTREAM, UNBRANDED. Loose ghee comes from local dairy 'Hygienic Milk' (1,114 L) and from the institution's own 'Akal Modi Khana - Baru Sahib' (260 L); separately ARY buys ₹13,09,165/yr from 'Purambika Desi Cow Natural Farming Inputs Llp'. So the A2/natural-farming ghee the ideal list calls the highest-growth premium line is already in the building — it just has no branded, packed, priced SKU on the shelf.

COUNTER CONCENTRATION: of ₹30.21 L, Ary Pos does ₹24.42 L across 45 SKUs, Basement does ₹5.66 L across just FOUR SKUs (Fortune Soya 1 Ltr, Soyabean Fortune_L, Desi Ghee 1 Ltr, Desi Ghee 1 Kg_L) — Basement is the de facto bulk/institutional counter — and Ary Clothing sold ₹12,237 of cooking oil and ghee, including half a litre of loose ghee. Ary G Canteen, Ary Lite and Fruits & Vegetables sell none of it.

DATA CAVEAT: 'ary assort probe' ANDs multiple terms rather than OR-ing them despite its --help text ('Several terms are OR-ed'). 'probe mustard sarson kachi ghani' returns 0 SKUs while 'probe mustard' returns 35. Every multi-word line here was therefore verified with single-term probes plus direct SQL against SaleDetail×SaleHeader (window 2025-08-28 → 2026-08-28, validated to the rupee against probe output on 07NI).
